neighbours.label: the piece 'oid' as its own token (lip|oid, sarcomat|oid, rhomb|oid)
fire: Biopsy showed a sarcomatoid pattern in the kidney.
The lipoid material collects inside the cell.
Its shape is a rhomboid with four sharp corners.
Tiny ovoid spores floated in the sample.
Epithelioid cells lined the small vessels.
Roasting forms melanoidins in the coffee beans.
The planet is an oblate spheroid in the model.
The bone has a sesamoid shape.
quiet: Biopsy showed a normal pattern in the kidney.
The thyroid gland sits inside the neck.
Its shape is a square with four sharp corners.
Tiny round spores floated in the sample.
Opioid drugs relaxed the small vessels.
Roasting browns the sugar in the coffee beans.
An asteroid was tracked by the left telescope.
The phone runs Android on a flat screen.

notes: The whole-token words ' thyroid', ' Opioid', ' asteroid' and ' Android' are the near misses: they contain the letters but not the piece.
